verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; heating campaigns must launch now.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 32 leads at an average cost of $40.17 per lead, but the past 7 days tell a harder story: leads fell 58% week-over-week while cost per lead more than doubled, with the final three days of October producing nearly zero. The drop traces to Meta losing efficiency and, critically, to heating campaigns that were scheduled to go live in October but have not yet launched — organic demand is actually rising (Google Business Profile actions surged 183% in the last 7 days, with 20 calls and 137 direction requests this period), which means the audience is there but paid campaigns are not capturing it. Launching the heating campaigns across Google and Meta is the immediate priority this week. Once those are live, cost per lead should normalize and volume should recover heading into peak heating season.

watch_item.fix: Heating campaigns for Google and Meta are being activated this week to capture the organic demand already showing up in your profile.
